title: E2HiL: Entropy-Guided Sample Selection for Efficient Real-World Human-in-the-Loop Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2601.19969v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Human-in-the-loop guidance has emerged as an effective approach for accelerating online reinforcement learning (RL) in real-world manipulation. However, existing human-in-the-loop RL (HiL-RL) frameworks often suffer from low sample efficiency, requiring substantial human interventions to achieve convergence and thereby leading to high labor costs. To address this, we propose a sample-efficient real-world human-in-the-loop RL framework named E2HiL, which requires fewer human interventions by actively selecting informative samples. Specifically, stable reduction of policy entropy enables improved trade-off between exploration and exploitation with higher sample efficiency. We first build influence functions of different samples on the policy entropy, which is efficiently estimated by the covariance of action probabilities and soft advantages of policies. translated_title: E2HiL：基于熵引导的样本选择用于高效真实世界人在回路强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2601.19969v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：人在回路引导已成为加速真实世界操作中在线强化学习（RL）的有效方法。然而，现有的人在回路强化学习（HiL-RL）框架通常面临样本效率低下的问题，需要大量人工干预才能实现收敛，从而导致高昂的人力成本。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种名为E2HiL的样本高效真实世界人在回路强化学习框架，该框架通过主动选择信息丰富的样本来减少人工干预。具体而言，策略熵的稳定降低能够改善探索与利用之间的权衡，从而提高样本效率。我们首先构建不同样本对策略熵的影响函数，该函数通过动作概率的协方差和策略的软优势进行高效估计。然后，我们选择影响函数值适中的样本，其中……
tldr: 本文提出了E2HiL框架，通过基于策略熵的影响函数主动选择中等信息量的样本，显著减少真实世界人在回路强化学习所需的人工干预次数，提升样本效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes E2HiL, a framework that actively selects samples with moderate influence on policy entropy via influence functions, significantly reducing human interventions and improving sample efficiency in real-world human-in-the-loop reinforcement learning.
